redesign_context: Vcharo is moving from a faded editorial look to a vibrant, energetic, and highly interactive UI inspired by topmate.io. The goal is to feel welcoming to Tier 2/3 students while maintaining premium quality. The final style will be decided by the user based on the mockups in /app/design_variants/.

brand_preservation.devanagari_accent: Rozha One font must be retained strictly for the word 'विचार'.
brand_preservation.core_content: All routes, 10 verified mentors, and exact text content must remain intact. We are only changing the visual wrapper.

direction_A_blockparty.theme: Closest match to Topmate.io. Friendly, chunky, pastel pops.
direction_A_blockparty.colors: Base: #F9FAFB. Accents: Vibrant Orange (#EA580C), Mint, Lavender. Cards: Solid whites or pale pastels.
direction_A_blockparty.shapes: Heavily rounded corners (rounded-[2rem] to rounded-full). Pill-shaped buttons.
direction_A_blockparty.motion: Bouncy hover states (-translate-y-1 or -translate-y-2), soft drop shadows.

direction_B_neobrutalist.theme: Edgier, Gen-Z creator vibe. Loud and structured.
direction_B_neobrutalist.colors: Base: #FFF9E6. Accents: Cyan, Hot Pink, Yellow. High contrast.
direction_B_neobrutalist.shapes: Harsh 4px black borders, sharp corners or tight radius (rounded-md).

direction_C_vibrantglass.theme: Premium, slightly techy, dark mode playful.
direction_C_vibrantglass.colors: Base: Deep Slate/Navy (#0F172A). Accents: Gradients (Pink to Sky Blue).
direction_C_vibrantglass.shapes: Glassmorphism cards (bg-white/5 with backdrop-blur), rounded-2xl to rounded-[1.5rem].

instructions_to_main_agent.action: Do NOT implement code yet. Wait for the user to select Direction A, B, or C. Once selected, apply the corresponding rules to the Tailwind config, layout containers, and shadcn component overrides across all routes.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing_requirement: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Ensure glass-morphism uses proper backdrop filters (12-24px blur) if chosen.
Do not center align the root app container text.
Use modern interactive button styles appropriate to the chosen direction.
Never use generic AI emojis for icons; use Lucide React icons.
Ensure micro-animations on hover states for all interactive elements.
